case01.title: First-time setup with an opening mismatch blocks Complete while Draft saves
steps: Open /accounting/bank-reconciliations/create, choose 1200 CIMB (no previous reconciliation)
Classify all three pre-period entries as Outstanding (cleared net 0.00, so opening does not agree)
Tick JE-QA-J1 (in 500.00) and JE-QA-J2 (out 300.00)

assertions.text: First-time setup section is shown with "3 unclassified"
Opening Balance Difference shows 1,000.00
Summary: Money In 500.00, Money Out 300.00, Calculated Closing 1,200.00
Create is enabled although the opening gate fails
Database: saved as DRAFT, sequence 1, with a BR number
Detail page: Complete is disabled
Detail page shows the blocker "Opening Balance Difference is <amount>"

case02.title: Exact closing match completes
steps: Open the Draft from case 1 and check the Matched tab lists the two ticked entries
Edit: reclassify JE-QA-P1 (in 1,000.00) as Already cleared
Click Complete and confirm

assertions.text: Draft detail: the Matched tab lists JE-QA-J1 and JE-QA-J2
Draft detail: Cleared at setup is empty before P1 is reclassified
Draft detail: the Outstanding tab lists unticked entries (JE-QA-R1 shown)
Opening Balance Difference becomes 0.00 and 0 unclassified
Detail page: Complete is enabled with no blockers
Confirmation states the lock and that no journal entries are changed

assertions.text: Database: status COMPLETED with currentVersionNo 1
Database: one sealed version, totals 500/300, difference 0, completedBy admin
Version lines: 2 MATCHED, 1 OPENING_CLEARED, the rest OUTSTANDING
Page shows "Completed by admin on <date>"
assertions.actual: Completed by admin on 05/10/2026SummaryTotal Money InMYR 500

assertions.text: No reconciliation draft remains in sessionStorage

assertions.text: EDIT: navigated to the journal entry page in the same tab

case09.title: Two-tab concurrency
steps: Tab B opens the same draft in Edit (lockVersion 1); Tab A already has it open
Tab A: Closing 500.00, Save Changes
Tab B: Closing 777.00, Save Changes with stale lockVersion 1

assertions.text: Tab B starts from server state (Closing 1260.00), not Tab A's unsaved draft: sessionStorage is per tab
Tab A saved: Closing 500.0000, lockVersion 2
Tab B shows the server's conflict message
assertions.actual: ["This reconciliation was changed elsewhere after you opened it. Reload the page to load the current version. Your unsaved changes cannot be saved over it.","This reconciliation was changed by someone else. Reload to continue."]

assertions.text: Tab B stays on the edit form with 777.00 intact
Server state not overwritten: still 500.0000, lockVersion 2
Tab B explains that the record changed elsewhere and must be reloaded
Tab B cannot save again over the newer version: Save Changes is disabled
Tab B keeps its unsaved draft, still at the lockVersion it was loaded from (1)
Server state still 500.0000 at lockVersion 2 after Tab B's attempt

case11.title: Stale-version recovery
steps: Tab B holds a stored draft at lockVersion 1 (Closing 777.00); the server is now at lockVersion 2. Reload Tab B's edit page

assertions.text: The exact warning text is shown
The current server state is loaded (Closing 500.00)
The stale stored draft is gone (none stored, or re-stored at lockVersion 2 with server values)

assertions.text: Redirected to the list
Notification "Draft discarded" appears
Database: the draft row is gone
Database: its reservations are released
Database: the number counter did not go back (next is 3)

case08.title: Cancel Reopen
steps: Open completed January (latest on the account, no draft exists) and Reopen
Edit: Closing 999.00, untick JE-QA-J2, reclassify JE-QA-P2 to Already cleared, Save
Cancel Reopen and confirm

assertions.text: Status is Draft and the reopened banner names the completion date
assertions.actual: Reopened. Cancel Reopen restores the version completed on 05/10/2026.

assertions.text: Reservations are kept while reopened
The edits are saved to the working set (it now differs from the completed state)
Confirmation explains the effect: discards changes since reopening, restores exactly, no journals changed
assertions.actual: Cancel reopen?This discards every change made since reopening and restores the reconciliation exactly as it was last completed, including its balances and matched entries. No journal entries are changed.CancelCancel Reopen

assertions.text: Header business fields equal the pre-reopen capture
Working lines (journal no, kind, original addedBy/addedAt) equal the pre-reopen capture
Setup marks (journal no, original markedBy/markedAt) equal the pre-reopen capture
lockVersion advanced and was not restored
No version was appended (still 1)
Audit history keeps REOPEN and CANCEL_REOPEN
No stored draft remains
